# Ada Lovelace

**Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace** (*née* **Byron**; 10 December 1815 – 27 November 1852) was an English [mathematician](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematician "Mathematician") and writer.<sup>[\[1\]](#cite_note-1)</sup> She is chiefly known for her work on the [Analytical Engine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Analytical_Engine "Analytical Engine").

## Biography

Her notes contain what is considered the first algorithm, computing Bernoulli numbers ${\displaystyle B_{n}}$.
